allowed_files: specs/epic-compaction-tool/spec.md (Design Decision 5 wording + dated Amendments entry)
specs/epic-compaction-tool/acceptance-criteria.md (only if wording accepted the old residual)
server/ollama-client.ts (completed responses always carry a usage object)
server/response-usage.ts (no meta step for an empty usage on an empty response)
constraints: lastUsedTokens: a step whose usage object has no numeric inputTokens/outputTokens is a response boundary -> undefined; results for histories whose latest response has numeric usage are unchanged
keep assistant-without-usage stop and the stream- filter in computeContextFill
stream_options retry only on HTTP 4xx whose body mentions stream_options or include_usage; at most one retry per request; remembered per provider base URL, in-process module state
completed streams always attach a usage object (possibly empty); interrupted streams unchanged; stream_options fallback excludes 401/403/429 and remembers a base URL only after a successful retry
error-body read for the stream_options check is bounded (8 KiB, 2 s) and falls back to the original status error
non_goals: no change to Ollama request/parsing paths; the only Ollama change is attaching a (possibly empty) usage object to completed responses (round 2)
